concerns.text: The plan uses the Materials Project dataset despite it not being listed in the verified‑datasets block, which violates Constitution Principle II (Verified Accuracy). The amendment (AMP‑001) documents the limitation but does not provide a verified citation, so the use of an unverified source remains a breach.

The Contract Traceability table lists four contracts (dataset, model_metrics, feature_importance, collinearity_diagnostic) but omits the `model_output.schema.yaml` contract, even though the plan references associational framing and final report generation that should be validated against this contract.
